title: CompletionTokenResponse
description: Response of POST /api/connectors/pending and POST /api/connectors/:id/completion-token (HEL-955 design.md D9). The ONLY responses that ever carry the raw completion-token secret -- never re-readable afterward.

token.description: The raw completion-token secret. Returned ONLY here, exactly once. The client composes the completion URL from this value plus its own frontend origin (e.g. /connectors/complete?token=...) -- never a fully-qualified URL from the backend.
